metadata.description: Metaphysical concepts explained in Ernest Holmes' voice

explanations.explanation: The Law of Mind is the fundamental principle that governs all creation. It is the Creative Power that brings all things into manifestation through the medium of thought. This Law operates impersonally, responding to our recognition of It, and never fails to bring into our experience that which we consciously accept as true.

Spiritual Substance is the essence of all things, the invisible reality that underlies all visible form. It is the Creative Power that takes form through our thoughts and beliefs. This Substance is infinite in nature, unlimited in supply, and responds to our recognition of Its presence. It is the raw material from which all things are created.

Divine Intelligence is the guiding force within each of us, the spark of the Infinite that lives in every human soul. It is the Creative Power that knows all things, sees all things, and can do all things. This Intelligence is not separate from us, but is the very essence of our being, waiting to be recognized and expressed.

The Principle is the fundamental law of the universe, the Creative Power that never fails to respond to our recognition of It. It is not a person, but a law as reliable as the law of gravity. The Principle operates through our consciousness, bringing into manifestation that which we consciously accept as true.

Mental equivalents are the thoughts and beliefs that correspond to the experiences we wish to have. The Science of Mind teaches that we must create the mental equivalent of what we desire before it can manifest in our experience. Our thoughts become things through the operation of Spiritual Law.
